_comment: The 26 services listed on the old website, grouped. One-line descriptions were drafted for review — Shastriji should confirm wording. Add 'dakshina' to an item to show a suggested offering.

items.name: Ganesh Poojan
items.desc: Worship of Shri Ganesh to remove obstacles — at the start of a new venture, a new home or any auspicious occasion.

items.name: Lakshmi Poojan
items.desc: Worship of Maa Lakshmi for prosperity and well-being, especially on Diwali and Sharad Purnima.

items.name: Satya Narayan Katha
items.desc: Puja and recitation of the Satyanarayan Vrat Katha, often on Purnima or to mark a family milestone.

items.name: Markandeya Poojan
items.desc: Puja invoking Rishi Markandeya for long life, health and protection.

items.name: Vahan Poojan
items.desc: Blessing of a new vehicle for safe travel.

items.name: Ganesh Havan
items.desc: Fire ceremony (havan) dedicated to Shri Ganesh.

items.name: Lakshmi Havan
items.desc: Fire ceremony dedicated to Maa Lakshmi, seeking prosperity and abundance.

items.name: Ganesh Yagya
items.desc: An elaborate yagya to Shri Ganesh with mantra japa and ahuti.

items.name: Navchandi Yagya
items.desc: Yagya to the Divine Mother with recitation of the Durga Saptashati — during Navratri or for a special sankalp.

items.name: Rudrabhishek
items.desc: Abhishek of the Shiva Linga with chanting of the Rudri (Shri Rudram) — for peace, health and relief from afflictions.

items.name: Laghurudra
items.desc: Extended Rudrabhishek with 121 recitations of the Rudri, performed by several priests over a day.

items.name: Kaal Sarp Dosh Shanti
items.desc: Remedial puja for Kaal Sarp yoga in the horoscope.

items.name: Shani Shanti
items.desc: Puja to pacify Shani (Saturn), especially during Sade Sati or Dhaiya.

items.name: Vastu Shanti
items.desc: Griha pravesh puja for a new home or workplace, harmonizing the space as per Vastu.

items.name: Nakshatra Shanti
items.desc: Remedial puja for a birth in certain nakshatras such as Mool or Ashlesha, usually performed for a newborn.

items.name: Navagraha Shanti
items.desc: Puja to the nine planets to reduce adverse planetary effects.

items.name: Sarp Bali
items.desc: Remedial ritual for sarpa dosha and related afflictions.

items.name: Naam Karan Sanskar
items.desc: Naming ceremony of a newborn.

items.name: Shimant Sanskar
items.desc: Blessing ceremony (godh bharai / seemant) for an expectant mother, usually in the seventh month.

items.name: Chaul Sanskar
items.desc: First haircut (mundan) ceremony of a child.

items.name: Yagnopavit (Upanayan)
items.desc: Sacred thread ceremony.

items.name: Engagement
items.desc: Sagai / ring ceremony with Vedic blessings.

items.name: Marriage Ceremony
items.desc: Complete Vedic vivah — Ganesh puja, kanyadaan, mangal phera and saptapadi.

items.name: Shraddha Karma
items.desc: Tarpan and pind daan in memory of departed ancestors, especially during Pitru Paksha.

items.name: Narayan Bali
items.desc: Ritual for the peace of departed souls, particularly after an untimely death.

items.name: Antyeshthi Karma
items.desc: Last rites and the ceremonies that follow.
